target: Build a runnable demonstration of program synthesis using a specification-to-program trial. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Implement program synthesis — real time
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of program synthesis using a specification-to-program trial. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a specification-to-program trial.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report hidden-test pass rate and complexity with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: overfitting visible examples.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of program synthesis.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report hidden-test pass rate and complexity against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for overfitting visible examples; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
